purpose: Draft project-template catalog for Cebu construction projects. Structure only: no materials, quantities, prices, assignees, progress, or BOM data.

dateRules.dueOffsetDays: Days after the anchor. Planning milestones and tasks count from the project's target date of development (startDate). Construction milestones and tasks count from the target date of construction (constructionStartDate, falling back to startDate).
dateRules.note: A calculated date past its phase window is saved, with a warning, like any other date the PM enters.

taskRules.planningTasks: Planning-phase milestones: tasks are Handled by GM or PM (handledBy). No Site Manager.
taskRules.constructionTasks: Construction-phase milestones: tasks are assigned to the project's Site Manager (no handledBy).
taskRules.defaultIncluded: Shown as a checkbox on the GM's document checklist. Standard documents start checked, conditional requirements start unchecked. Unchecked items are never created.
taskRules.permitTasksAre: document and approval checkpoints, not material or cost records

The 12 standard documents are included in every template, including civil, drainage and road templates, where electrical, sanitary and plumbing permits may not apply. The GM unchecks what does not apply.

Closeout documents (Certificate of Occupancy, FSIC, as-built records) are Construction-phase tasks: the Site Manager photographs the issued document and the PM acknowledges it, so they follow the existing F5 flow.
Which conditional requirements each template offers (offeredConditionalCodes) is a proposal and needs review.
The templates intentionally exclude prices, quantities, material names, assignees, progress, tickets, expenses, receipts, and notes.
